title: Pure Charity
summary: The Charity series represents the TCG-legal 'Charity' draw cards centered around Common Charity and Graceful Tear mechanics. Using Normal Monster Gemini/Fairies and Dark Factory of Mass Production, the deck banishes Normal Monsters via Common Charity to draw deep into the deck and recur banished bodies.

allow.Dunames Dark Witch: Classic Level 4 Normal Monster depicted alongside Graceful Charity lore that fuels Common Charity and Unexpected Dai.
allow.Angel Trumpeter: Level 4 Normal Tuner monster that can be banished for Common Charity or used for Level 8 Synchro plays.
allow.Mystical Shine Ball: Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monster summoned by Venus or banished via Common Charity.
allow.The Agent of Creation - Venus: Pays 500 LP to summon Mystical Shine Balls from the Deck to fuel Link plays or keep in hand for Common Charity.
allow.Rescue Rabbit: Banishes itself to summon 2 Normal Monsters from the Deck for instant Xyz or Link plays.
allow.Treasure Panda: Banishes Spell/Traps from the GY to summon Normal Monsters from the Deck.
allow.Lullaby of Obedience: Charity/obedience Spell that declares a monster to add or summon from the opponent's Deck.
allow.Unexpected Dai: Special Summons Angel Trumpeter or Dunames Dark Witch directly from the Deck.
allow.White Elephant's Gift: Sends 1 face-up non-Effect Monster you control to the GY to draw 2 cards.
allow.Dark Factory of Mass Production: Recovers 2 Normal Monsters from the GY back to the hand to guarantee live targets for Common Charity.
allow.Avenging Knight Parshath: Level 8 LIGHT Fairy Synchro made with Angel Trumpeter + Level 4 Fairy that pierces and draws cards.

main: Dunames Dark Witch
Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monster with 1800 ATK that fuels Common Charity and White Elephant's Gift.
Angel Trumpeter
Level 4 EARTH Plant Normal Tuner with 1900 ATK that fuels Common Charity and enables Level 8 Synchros.
Mystical Shine Ball
Level 2 LIGHT Fairy Normal Monster summoned by Venus or banished via Common Charity.
The Agent of Creation - Venus
Summons up to 3 Mystical Shine Balls from hand or Deck to convert into Link/Synchro material or White Elephant's Gift draw fodder.
Rescue Rabbit
Summons 2 Dunames Dark Witch or 2 Angel Trumpeter directly from the Deck.
Treasure Panda
Banishes used Charity Traps/Spells from the GY to Special Summon Normal Monsters from the Deck.
Common Charity
Signature Trap that draws 2 cards and banishes 1 Normal Monster from your hand.
Lullaby of Obedience
Charity/obedience Spell that declares a monster to add or summon from the opponent's Deck.
Graceful Tear
Trap that gives 1 card in your hand to the opponent to gain 2000 LP, referencing the Graceful Charity angel.
Unexpected Dai
Summons Dunames Dark Witch or Angel Trumpeter from the Deck.
White Elephant's Gift
Sends a face-up Normal Monster to the GY to draw 2 cards.
Dark Factory of Mass Production
Adds 2 Normal Monsters from the GY to the hand to keep Common Charity live.
extra: Level 8 Synchro made with Angel Trumpeter + Level 4 that pierces and changes battle positions.
